shots.description: Fixed wide view across a blue indoor badminton court with green side borders and white lines. A foreground player in a black short-sleeved shirt with pink graphics on the back, light gray shorts, dark socks, and athletic shoes stands near center facing away from the camera toward the net. Across the net, another player in a dark top and dark lower garment is visible at midcourt. The far-side player feeds shuttlecocks over the net; the foreground player moves laterally and forward-backward to hit them with a racket. Banners hang high in the background.

Same fixed wide angle continues after a cut or change in setup within the same court scene. The foreground now shows a different player wearing a dark sleeveless outer layer over a white short-sleeved shirt, black shorts, dark socks, and athletic shoes, standing nearer the right half of the near court and facing the net. Across the net, a feeder in a dark maroon/burgundy top and light-colored pants repeatedly sends shuttlecocks over. The near player mostly watches and makes small preparatory movements rather than clearly striking each feed during this interval.

tail_observation.description: Near the end, both players remain on opposite sides of the net in the same wide court view. The near player in the dark sleeveless top over a white shirt stays poised on the right side of the near court while the far-side feeder in a maroon/burgundy top and light pants remains active around the service area. No new action beyond continued feeding/preparation is clearly completed before the clip ends.
readable_text: 旭日星空 XURI STAR 专业羽毛球学院

racket_and_shuttle_events.actor: far-side player across the net in first shot; near-side player in black shirt in first shot
racket_and_shuttle_events.description: The far-side player delivers shuttlecocks by hand/rack over the net into play. The near-side player receives these feeds and performs racket strokes back across the net. Exact contact instants are brief but repeated overhead returns are visible.

racket_and_shuttle_events.actor: same two players in first shot
racket_and_shuttle_events.description: Additional shuttlecock feeds continue from the far side. The near-side player shifts position and hits more return shots with the racket. One later exchange appears closer to the net line, suggesting varied placement of the incoming shuttles.

racket_and_shuttle_events.actor: far-side feeder in maroon/burgundy top; near-side player in dark sleeveless top over white shirt
racket_and_shuttle_events.description: A shuttlecock is sent from the far side toward the near court. The near-side player tracks it and prepares with racket raised, but clear completed contact is uncertain in this early part of the second shot.

racket_and_shuttle_events.actor: far-side feeder in maroon/burgundy top; near-side player in dark sleeveless top over white shirt
racket_and_shuttle_events.description: More shuttlecocks are fed over the net by the far-side player. The near-side player remains in ready posture and may make limited racket handling motions, but distinct successful strikes are not consistently visible before the clip ends.

footwork_observations.actor: near-side player in black shirt, first shot
footwork_observations.description: He begins in a low ready stance, then shuffles laterally and steps forward/backward to meet incoming shuttles. Foot changes are quick and compact, consistent with receiving practice feeds.

footwork_observations.actor: near-side player in black shirt, first shot
footwork_observations.description: He continues dynamic footwork with side-to-side adjustments and short lunging recoveries after each stroke. His feet reset between shots rather than staying planted.

footwork_observations.actor: far-side feeder in maroon/burgundy top, second shot
footwork_observations.description: The feeder takes small positioning steps around the service/training area while sending multiple shuttlecocks. Movement is controlled and repetitive rather than sprint-like.

footwork_observations.actor: near-side player in dark sleeveless top over white shirt, second shot
footwork_observations.description: He mostly holds a ready base on the near-right side with minor weight shifts and short adjustment steps. Large explosive movement is not clearly sustained in this segment.

footwork_observations.actor: far-side feeder in maroon/burgundy top, second shot
footwork_observations.description: The feeder keeps stepping lightly to reposition for successive deliveries, alternating between crouched preparation and upright follow-through posture.

uncertainties: Only sampled frames up to about 7.6 seconds are directly available, so any activity between approximately 7.6 and 8.0 seconds is unobserved.
In the second shot, some near-side racket contacts are ambiguous because the player often appears to prepare or track the shuttle without a clearly visible completed strike.
Exact clothing details of the far-side player in the first shot are less certain due to distance and motion blur.
Speech timing is approximate relative to the visuals, and no subtitle text should be treated as spoken dialogue unless separately audible.
